title: Recovering Unobserved Network Links from Aggregated Relational Data: Bayesian Latent Surface Modeling and Penalized Regression
abstract: arXiv:2501.10675v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Aggregated relational data (ARD) record counts of ties to attribute-defined groups while leaving individual edges unobserved. We compare latent-geometry and regularized network estimators through a common observation map. The comparison distinguishes the realized adjacency matrix, conditional edge probabilities, and model parameters. We study roster-based ARD with known node-level group memberships, giving both estimators the same roster and aggregate counts.   We relate the aggregate means to a Poisson working likelihood and a Huber loss, and give their derivatives. Overlapping groups, shared edges, and reporting error affect the interpretation of these objectives. Geometry restricts the representation of edge probabilities, while regularization selects among candidate fits. Identification depends on the observation map and model restrictions rather than uniqueness of a numerical optimizer.   A reproducible synthetic experiment spec

translated_title: 从聚合关系数据中恢复未观测的网络链接：贝叶斯潜在曲面建模与惩罚回归
translated_abstract: 聚合关系数据（ARD）记录的是与属性定义群体之间关联的数量，而个体间的边保持未被观测。我们通过一个共同的观测映射，对潜在几何方法与正则化网络估计器进行比较。该比较区分了实现的邻接矩阵、条件边概率以及模型参数。我们研究了基于花名册且节点级群体成员信息已知的ARD，为两种估计器提供相同的花名册和聚合计数。我们将聚合均值与泊松工作似然和Huber损失联系起来，并给出它们的导数。群体的重叠、共享的边以及报告误差会影响对这些目标函数的解释。几何方法限制了边概率的表示方式，而正则化则在候选拟合之间进行选择。可识别性取决于观测映射和模型限制，而非数值优化器的唯一性。一个可复现的合成实验规范……
tldr: 该论文通过统一的观测映射框架，比较了贝叶斯潜在几何模型与惩罚回归两类网络估计器在从聚合关系数据（ARD）中恢复未观测网络链接上的表现，并指出可识别性取决于观测映射和模型限制而非数值优化器的唯一性。
en_tdlr: This paper compares Bayesian latent-geometry models and penalized regression estimators through a unified observation map to recover unobserved network links from aggregated relational data (ARD), showing that identification depends on the observation map and model restrictions rather than the uniqueness of a numerical optimizer.
